summary: Applied both spec-review blocking findings by adding explicit metadata owner mapping for independent core commands and concrete help invocation surface ownership.

items.title: Independent core commands have no metadata owner
items.rationale: Added an overview module entry, migration decision, R11, acceptance criteria, and task acceptance item naming metadata owners for `help`, `setup`, `upgrade`, `plugin`, and `presets list`.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.modules, overview.decisions, requirements[R11], acceptance_criteria, and tasks[T-2].acceptance now map independent top-level core commands to command metadata ownership while retaining execution entrypoints.

items.title: Public help invocation surfaces are not mapped to renderer ownership
items.rationale: Added concrete CLI help invocation ownership mapping for global help, `senti help <...>`, core namespace/leaf `--help`, plugin help through `senti help`, and direct plugin `--help` while preserving non-help execution owners.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow, overview.decisions, requirements[R12], acceptance_criteria, and tasks[T-4].acceptance now enumerate renderer-backed help paths and unchanged non-help execution ownership.
